title: Canonical module-to-set etale inverse-image comparison
statement: Let $R$ be any ring, $g:X\to Y$ any morphism of schemes, and $G$ a sheaf of $R$-modules on the small etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $U_X,U_Y$ forget module coefficients to sets. The canonical map $g^{-1}_{Set}(U_YG)\to U_X(g^{-1}_{Mod}G)$, defined as the adjoint transpose of $U_Y(G\to g_*g^{-1}_{Mod}G)$ using the set inverse-image adjunction, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Module inverse-image adjunction; its concrete Kan-extension/sheafification compatibility, as used in lem-sc-algclosed-extension-module-sections proof step 2. Mathlib canonical comparison identities.

proof.text: Base change is representably flat. Thus its opposite comma categories are filtered. Use preservation of filtered colimits by the module forgetful functor (shrinking the hom universe from u+1 to u) and pointwise Kan-extension preservation to construct lanCompIsoOfPreserves.

Use sheafComposeNatIso for the module forgetful functor, which preserves sheafification. Compose its component with sheafification applied to the inverse of the Kan-extension comparison. Both are isomorphisms.

Expand the units of the restricted Kan-extension/sheafification adjunctions. Naturality of the sheafification unit, sheafComposeNatTrans_fac and leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves_inv_fac show that the composite is the adjoint transpose of the forgotten module unit. Therefore that transpose is invertible.

theorem isIso_upperStar_forget_comparison (R : Type (u + 1)) [Ring R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) :
    IsIso (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g) (Type (u + 1))
      (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology (Q := @Etale) @Etale)
      (X.smallGrothendieckTopology (Q := @Etale) @Etale)).homEquiv
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology (forget (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))).obj G)
      ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (forget (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))).obj
        ((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} R].obj G))).symm
        ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology (forget (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))).map
          ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) g).unit.app G)))
